items.title: Israeli intelligence chief's brother charged with smuggling cigarettes into Gaza

items.summary: Israeli prosecutors have charged the brother of the head of the country's intelligence agency, Shin Bet, with "aiding the enemy in wartime" by allegedly smuggling cigarettes into Gaza.

items.title: 55,000 Ukrainian soldiers killed in war with Russia, Zelensky says
items.title_zh: 泽连斯基说:
items.summary: The number of Ukrainian soldiers killed on the battlefield in the four years of war with Russia is 55,000, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
items.summary_zh: 沃洛季米尔·泽连斯基总统说,在与俄罗斯四年战争中在战场上阵亡的乌克兰士兵人数为55,000人.

items.title: US and Iran agree to hold nuclear talks in Oman on Friday
items.title_zh: 美国和伊朗同意星期五在阿曼举行核会谈
items.summary: The US and Iran have agreed to hold nuclear talks in Oman on Friday, as President Donald Trump issued a blunt warning to Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
items.summary_zh: 美国和伊朗已同意星期五在阿曼举行核会谈,因为唐纳德·特朗普总统向最高领导人阿亚图拉阿里·哈梅内伊发出钝意警告.

items.title: Japanese city cancels cherry blossom festival over badly behaved tourists

items.title: Aid workers missing after airstrikes hit South Sudan hospital

items.summary: An unknown number of aid workers are missing after air strikes hit a hospital in South Sudan, near the Ethiopian border, a charity group says.
items.summary_zh: 一个慈善团体说,在南苏丹边境附近的一所医院遭到空袭后,数目不明的援助人员失踪。

items.summary: China's leader Xi Jinping has called Taiwan "the most important issue" in China-US relations during a phone call with US President Donald Trump.

items.summary_zh: 警方称一名疑犯已确认失踪 四岁男孩在南澳大利亚后卫失踪.

items.title: Watch: Inside Gaza hospital struggling to provide care to newborn babies

items.summary: The director of one of Gaza's main hospitals says he is still seeing a pattern of malnourished and traumatised mothers giving birth to underweight or premature babies, more than three months into a fragile ceasefire between Hamas and Israel.
items.summary_zh: 加沙一家主要医院的院长说,他仍然看到营养不良和受创伤的母亲产下体重不足或早产婴儿的模式,在哈马斯和以色列之间脆弱的停火状态下,这已超过三个月。

items.title: Trump says America should move on from Epstein - it may not be that easy

items.summary: Black, crispy, often flat and square - dried seaweed, known locally as gim - is a humble staple on everyday dining tables across South Korea. But as its global popularity grows, its rising prices are worrying gim-lovers nationwide.
